title: El domingo
goal: Be pulled into somebody’s Sunday on the shore
culture: Sunday on the lakefront is families with pots of food, and they will feed you. Hesitating for one beat is polite; refusing outright is the only wrong answer on that beach. No sea pena means stop being shy and it is said to everybody.

beats.good: Siéntese from them, me siento from you. They do mean it, and hesitating for exactly one beat before accepting is the polite amount.
Hay bastante — there is plenty. There is never quite as much as they say and you are eating some of it regardless; that is the arrangement.

beats.objective: Say you are not being shy
beats.good: Pena is shyness and embarrassment at once. No sea pena is said to everybody who hesitates, and the correct response is to stop hesitating.
Sírvase — help yourself. Take a modest amount and say so out loud; taking nothing is the one move that would hurt somebody’s feelings.
